outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with raw western blot images; it is not a plot of averaged data.

Bar charts show single densitometry quantification values (% depletion, log2 elution) per antibody with no error bars or indication of replicate averaging, so there is no mean obscuring individual data points.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from this check.
Bar charts show mean ± SD (n=4) with individual data points overlaid as dots for each condition.
Panel F is a sequence alignment paired with a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G consists of scatter plots, where individual points are inherently the data shown; exempt from this check.
Panel H is a scatter plot of individual IP-MS experiments; points are already the individual data.
Panel I is a PCA scatter plot; individual points already represent individual samples/experiments.
Panel J is a set of PCA scatter plots; individual points already represent individual samples/experiments.
